_readme: CV PAGE. Sections appear in the order they are listed here, so you can reorder or delete them freely. Each section either pulls in shared content ("source": "education" | "projects" | "skills", taken from content/about.json, content/projects/ and content/skills.json) or holds its own items. A section with no items and no emptyState is not shown at all. To hide a section that currently only shows a placeholder, delete its emptyState line. Item shape: {"title": "", "subtitle": "", "date": "", "body": "", "bullets": [""], "links": [{"label": "", "file": "documents/..." or "url": "https://..."}]}
